description: Source code for FastAPI routes managing file uploads, listing, and deletions, including interactions with Supabase storage and database. Implements endpoints for listing user files, uploading files with validation, and deleting files with ownership checks.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Create a Supabase client using environment variables for URL and key.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extract the file extension from a filename, converted to lowercase.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Retrieve a list of files owned by the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handle file upload: validate extension and size, store in Supabase Storage, and record metadata in database.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Delete a specific file by ID if owned by current user, removing both storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Delete a file associated with a specific session, verifying ownership and session ID.

ctags.pattern: /^def delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None):$/
